description: This file defines a Backoff struct and related functions for implementing exponential backoff strategies, including jitter, reset, and timing mechanisms. It also provides functions for retry loops with backoff, including context-aware variants.

classes.name: Backoff
classes.description: Struct representing parameters for exponential backoff, including duration, factor, jitter, steps, and cap.

classes.name: BackoffManager
classes.description: Interface for managing backoff timers with methods Backoff() and Timer().

methods.name: Step
methods.description: Calculates the next sleep duration based on current backoff parameters, updating Steps and Duration.

methods.name: DelayFunc
methods.description: Returns a function that computes the next interval to wait, based on backoff parameters.

methods.name: Timer
methods.description: Returns a timer suitable for the backoff's parameters, either fixed, variable, or no-op.

methods.name: delay
methods.description: Core function implementing delay calculation with jitter, factor, and steps.

methods.name: DelayWithReset
methods.description: Returns a DelayFunc that resets backoff parameters periodically based on resetInterval.

methods.name: Until
methods.description: Runs a function periodically with jitter, until stop channel is closed.

methods.name: UntilWithContext
methods.description: Runs a function periodically with jitter, until context is done.

methods.name: NonSlidingUntil
methods.description: Runs a function periodically without sliding, until stop channel is closed.

methods.name: NonSlidingUntilWithContext
methods.description: Runs a function periodically without sliding, until context is done.

methods.name: JitterUntil
methods.description: Main loop for running a function periodically with optional jitter and sliding behavior.

methods.name: BackoffUntil
methods.description: Runs a function with backoff timing, until stop channel is closed.

methods.name: Step
methods.description: Returns the next duration to wait, with thread-safe reset logic.

methods.name: Backoff
methods.description: Returns a timer for exponential backoff, draining the previous timer if necessary.

methods.name: Timer
methods.description: Returns a shared timer instance for the backoff.

methods.name: getNextBackoff
methods.description: Calculates the next backoff duration, resetting if reset duration has passed.
